name: vibe-coding-workflow-system
description: Portable workflow-system for Vibe Coding project governance.

scripts.gen:all: bun run gen:workflow-skills && bun run gen:workflow-docs && bun run gen:registry
scripts.test:workflow-skills: bun run gen:workflow-skills --dry-run && bun test test/gen-workflow-skills.test.ts && bun run test:workflow-capabilities
scripts.test:workflow-docs: bun run gen:workflow-docs --dry-run && bun test test/gen-workflow-docs.test.ts
scripts.test:registry: bun run gen:registry --dry-run && bun test test/gen-registry.test.ts
scripts.test:workflow-all: bun run test:workflow-skills && bun run test:workflow-docs && bun run test:registry && bun test test/bootstrap-project-governance.test.ts test/task-identity.test.ts test/validation-model.test.ts test/run-validation.test.ts test/workflow-core.test.ts test/workflow-runtime.test.ts
